name: jlcpcb
description: Parts orderable from LCSC and assembled by JLCPCB (basic parts where possible); LCSC numbers verified 2026-09-05

capacitor-0603.description: MLCC 0603. Give the LCSC part for the value, e.g. 100n=C14663 (YAGEO CC0603KRX7R9BB104, 50 V X7R, basic), 1u=C15849

capacitor-0805.description: MLCC 0805. Give the LCSC part for the value, e.g. 10u=C15850 (Samsung CL21A106KAYNNNE, 25 V X5R, basic)

led-0603-red.description: Red 0603 chip LED, KENTO KT-0603R, Vf 1.8–2.4 V (LCSC C2286, JLCPCB basic part)

ne555dr.description: Texas Instruments NE555DR precision timer, SOIC-8, 4.5–16 V (LCSC C7593, JLCPCB basic part); behavioural SPICE model

resistor-0603.description: Chip resistor 0603, 1%, 100 mW. Give the LCSC part for the value you use, e.g. 10k=C25804, 100k=C25803, 330=C23138, 1k=C21190 (JLCPCB basic parts)

solder-pads-2.description: Two exposed pads to solder supply wires to (+ and -); no part is placed, excluded from BOM/pick-and-place

led-duris-e-2835-cri90.description: OSRAM DURIS E 2835 GW JTLPS1.CM white LED, CRI 90 min / 92 typ, R9>=50, 150 mA nominal (250 mA max), Vf 2.70-3.30 V (2.94 typ), Rth 25 K/W. Stocked variant: 6500 K (LCSC C17297932); other CCTs of the same part use the same footprint

mosfet-aod482.description: AOS AOD482 N-channel MOSFET, 100 V, 32 A, 42 mΩ @ 4.5 V, Vgs(th) 1.6-2.7 V, TO-252 (LCSC C89735); fine as a linear current sink at ~1 W on an aluminium board

mosfet-2n7002.description: JSCJ 2N7002 N-channel MOSFET, 60 V, 115 mA, Vgs(th) 1-2.5 V, SOT-23 pins 1=G 2=S 3=D (LCSC C8545, JLCPCB basic)

cj431-sot23.description: JSCJ CJ431 adjustable shunt reference 2.495 V (TL431 equivalent), SOT-23 with pins 1=REF 2=CATHODE 3=ANODE (note: NOT the TI pinout); Ika min 1 mA (LCSC C3113, JLCPCB basic)

lm358-soic8.description: onsemi LM358DR2G dual op-amp, 3-32 V single supply, SOIC-8: 1 OUT1, 2 IN1-, 3 IN1+, 4 GND, 5 IN2+, 6 IN2-, 7 OUT2, 8 VCC (LCSC C7950, JLCPCB basic); behavioural model 100 dB, 1 MHz GBW, output swings to VCC-1.5 V

zener-bzt52c10.description: BZT52C10 zener 10 V 500 mW, SOD-123, pad 1 = cathode (LCSC C216719 Shikues)

resistor-1206.description: Chip resistor 1206, 250 mW, 200 V. LCSC per value: 3.3k=C26032 (UNI-ROYAL), 3.3Ω=C137283 (YAGEO RC1206FR-073R3L)

capacitor-1206.description: MLCC 1206. LCSC per value: 1u/100V X7R = C13832 (Samsung CL31B105KCHNNNE)

resistor-0805.description: Chip resistor 0805, 125 mW. LCSC per value: 0Ω jumper = C17477 (UNI-ROYAL, JLCPCB basic)

wago-2060-452.description: WAGO 2060-452/998-404 SMD push-in terminal block, 2 poles, 4 mm pitch, 24-18 AWG, 9 A / 63 V (IEC III/3); JLCPCB stocks it (C2765055) but it is marked hand-soldered (assembly: false) — set metadata.assembly true if you want JLCPCB to place it

al5809-60.description: Diodes AL5809-60P1-7 two-terminal 60 mA (±5%) constant-current LED regulator, 2.5-60 V across IN-OUT, PowerDI-123, 1.24 W on a good pad (LCSC C154921). Parallel several for more current; PWM 100-200 Hz via a low-side MOSFET on OUT (0.5 ms min on/off)

led-hongli-2835-hr6-6500k.description: HONGLITRONIC HL-AM-2835H421W-S1-08-HR6 2835 white LED, 6500 K (6000-7000 K), Ra 95, SDCM<6, 60 mA, Vf 2.8-3.4 V (3.1 typ), 120 deg, ~22 lm (LCSC C516135)

led-hongli-2835-hr6-2800k.description: HONGLITRONIC HL-AM-2835H421W-S1-08-HR6 2835 white LED, 2800 K (2800-3100 K), Ra 95, SDCM<6, 60 mA, Vf 2.8-3.4 V (3.1 typ), 120 deg (LCSC C516131). Same footprint and I-V model as the 6500 K part

led-xinglight-2835-blue.description: XINGLIGHT XL-2835UBC-02 2835 blue LED, 460 nm dominant (465 nm peak), 60 mA max continuous, 200 mW, Vf 3.4 V max (3.2 typ), 120 deg, 1.75 cd (LCSC C2843871). Note 60 mA is the ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM, flat only to ~30 C ambient: run it PWM'd, not DC

led-xinglight-2835-green.description: XINGLIGHT XL-2835UGC-02 2835 emerald green LED, 510 nm dominant (520 nm peak), 60 mA max continuous, 200 mW, Vf 3.6 V max (3.3 typ), 120 deg, 6 cd (LCSC C2843870). 60 mA is the absolute maximum: PWM it

led-togialed-3030-amber.description: TOGIALED TJ-S3030UG5W6TLC9Y-A5 3030 amber LED, 595 nm dominant (591 nm peak), 150 mA rated, 0.39 W, Vf 2.6 V typ at 150 mA (~2.4 V at 60 mA, extrapolated: MEASURE IT), 120 deg (LCSC C42389961)

led-jnj-2835-deepred.description: JNJ JNJ-L-2835CW-66018-S-G1 2835 deep red LED, 660 nm dominant, rated 20 mA in the catalogue (IF max 300 mA per datasheet), Vf 1.8 V at 20 mA (~1.9 V at 60 mA, extrapolated), 125 deg, 4 cd (LCSC C22447975)

schottky-ss34-sma.description: SS34 Schottky diode, 40 V 3 A, Vf 0.55 V at 3 A (~0.35 V at 0.3 A), SMA/DO-214AC (LCSC C8678, JLCPCB basic). Reverse-supply protection for rails up to ~30 V

capacitor-elec-6.3x7.7.description: SMD aluminium electrolytic, V-chip D6.3 x 7.7 mm. LCSC per value: 47u/50V = C72523 (ROQANG RVT1H470M0607, 2000 h @ 105 C); 100u/50V = C3151829 (RVT1H101M0607)

solder-pad-1.description: One 3 x 3 mm exposed pad to solder a wire to (control signal, ground reference); no part is placed, excluded from BOM/pick-and-place

resistor-2512.description: Chip resistor 2512, 1 W. LCSC per value (all 1 W 200 V thick film): 62R 1% = C2999540 (low stock), 68R 5% = C25492, 82R 1% = C3000773 (low stock), 91R 1% = C878260, 100R 1% = C35218 — stock as of 2026-09-07

jst-ph-s7b-sm4.description: JST S7B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN) PH 2.0 mm side-entry SMD header, 7 pins, 2 A / 100 V per pin, mates with PHR-7 housings (pre-crimped 7-pin PH cables are a commodity). LCSC C265453 (extended)

dcjack-pj-002ah-smt.description: CUI PJ-002AH-SMT-TR DC power jack, 5.5 mm barrel / 2.0 mm centre pin, 24 V 5 A, SMT with two plastic locating pegs (needs two non-plated holes; check peg length against the board thickness when the back is a heatsink). LCSC C22434687

led-xinglight-2835-yellowwhite.description: XINGLIGHT XL-2835YWC-02 2835 phosphor-converted 'yellow white' LED, 1800-1900 K, 60 mA, 200 mW, Vf 3.0-3.4 V, 120 deg, 5.5-6.2 cd (~18 lm). Almost all of its blue pump is converted by a broad yellow phosphor, so it plays the 'lime' role in a colour mix: one wide band filling 520-650 nm (LCSC C7371920). Same footprint as the XL-2835 blue/green

jst-ph-s8b-sm4.description: JST S8B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN) PH 2.0 mm side-entry SMD header, 8 pins, 2 A / 100 V per pin, mates with PHR-8 housings. LCSC C265121 (extended)

led-0805-violet-415.description: TUOZHAN P2-0805UVTCS2-0.8T 0805 violet LED, 410-420 nm peak (13 nm FWHM), 20 mA test / 30 mA max, Vf 2.8-3.4 V (3.0 typ), 90 mW, 120 deg, 10-50 mcd (LCSC C2827270). The violet primary below the whites' 450 nm pump; run on its own 20 mA regulator string

jst-ph-s9b-sm4.description: JST S9B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN) PH 2.0 mm side-entry SMD header, 9 pins, 2 A / 100 V per pin, mates with PHR-9 housings. LCSC C495694 (extended)

al5809-20.description: Diodes AL5809-20S1-7 two-terminal 20 mA (+-5%) constant-current LED regulator, 2.5-60 V across IN-OUT, SOD-123, 0.36 W (LCSC C332295). Same family as the al5809-60; for low-current strings such as 0805 indicator-class LEDs
